name: LaPorte County, IN
findings: LaPorte County has 366 nonprofit organizations. 156 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, LaPorte County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 36 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
